input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Services are warranted to be performed "in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards" with no time limit, and Services and Deliverables must "materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications" (19.1). On duration, hosted software conforms "throughout the subscription term" (continuous, and Order Forms renew in twelve-month periods under 8.2), which equals or exceeds the 12-month software element, and Deliverables carry 90 days from the later of delivery or acceptance — well beyond the 30/90-day fallback floors. Section 19.4 gives the full remedy ladder: prompt re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item and a refund of Fees paid, non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy and security claims. Vendor also warrants compliance with Applicable Law and against malicious code (19.3). Critically, the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty: 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties and states that "No disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity, confidentiality duty, data-protection duty, or remedy expressly provided here," and there is no "AS IS" language or exclusive-remedy cut-back anywhere (30.x confirms remedies are cumulative; 21.4 preserves caps only). Two points fall marginally short of preferred wording and are noted rather than redlined: the malicious-code warranty is qualified to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and Deliverable (as opposed to hosted software) conformance runs 90 days rather than 12 months. Neither is material given the continuous hosted-software warranty and the acceptance regime in 6.2, which independently provides correction cycles and a refund. No change requested.
